title: POST /api/encore/score-words: the request headers (§2.9)
description: The body is the recording itself (Opus audio, at most 8 MB), so what describes it travels in headers. Header names are case-insensitive; this schema uses the spelling of the fixtures.

Content-Type.description: Opus in Ogg or WebM (codec parameters allowed, e.g. audio/webm;codecs=opus), mono, at most 48 kb/s.

X-Encore-Base.description: The version played (its base); its words.json timing is used.

X-Encore-Start.description: Video time (seconds) at the recording's first sample, after the player's latency correction.

X-Encore-Rate.description: Playback rate for the whole recording (1.0 normally; 0.5 to 2.0).

X-Encore-Lines.description: Optional: the words.json line i values to score (duets: the singer's own lines). Left out: every line but backing lines.
